contentItem.englishTitle: A major straight line is divided at one and the same point only.

surfaces.text: A major straight line is divided at one and the same point only.
主要直线只在同一点上划分。（相关点与线段：A）

Let AB be a major straight line divided at C, so that AC, CB are incommensurable in square and make the sum of the squares on AC, CB rational, but the rectangle AC, CB medial; [[X. 39](/principles/euclid-10-39) ] I say that AB is not so divided at another point.
让AB成为一条主要直线,分为C,这样,正方形的AC,CB,不可公度,正方形的正方形,正方形和AC,CB,有理,矩形,CB,中项无理线段;] 我说,AB在另一个时候不是如此分割。 [ [X. 39](/principles/euclid-10-39)
For, if possible, let it be divided at D also, so that AD, DB are also incommensurable in square and make the sum of the squares on AD, DB rational, but the rectangle contained by them medial.
如果可能的话,也将其分为D,正方形AD,DB,不可公度,正方形正方形,正方形,,DB,有理,矩形,矩形,中项无理线段。

Then, since that by which the squares on AC, CB differ from the squares on AD, DB is also that by which twice the rectangle AD, DB differs from twice the rectangle AC, CB, while the squares on AC, CB exceed the squares on AD, DB by a rational area—for both are rational— therefore twice the rectangle AD, DB also exceeds twice the rectangle AC, CB by a rational area, though they are medial: which is impossible. [[X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26) ]
AC正方形ACADDB2 DB2 也是矩形ADADCB2倍的矩形ADACCB2倍的正方形ACACACAC正方形AD正方形有理有理有理DB2倍的矩形ADADDB2倍的矩形ACAC有理面积有理面积有理面积2倍的2倍的CB中项无理线段中项无理线段中项无理线段中项无理线段中项无理线段中项无理线段中项无理线段中项无理线段矩形矩形 [ [X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26)
Therefore a major straight line is not divided at different points; therefore it is only divided at one and the same point. Q. E. D.
因此,主要直线不在不同点上划分;因此,它只在同一点上划分。
